text:
Mike: Heads up — staging deploys failing on gitlab-runner when injecting SOPS secrets into Helm chart. Seen this once before?
Anya: Error? logs?
Mike: Runner log: "failed to decrypt secret: invalid key" then Helm replace fails with empty env var in pod.
SRE-bot: Deploy job #4523 failed: exit_code=1
Sofia: Did we rotate the KMS alias last night? That would break SOPS decrypt if CI didn't pick new key.
Mike: We rotated k8s KMS alias in terraform PR 789 but starter-runner-config uses encrypted SOPS key in gitlab CI variables, not from KMS. CI didn't get updated.
Rahul: Ah — we moved to kms alias 'redwood-sops-v2' and the old alias is scheduled for deletion. CI still uses sops_age or AGE_KEY? which one do our runners use now?
Anya: Runners use sops with age keys (file: .sops/age.key) for repo encryption, but for cluster sealed-secrets we use KMS-wrapped sops key in terraform state. There's a mismatch.
Mike: Repro steps: local `sops -d secrets/staging.yaml` works (using local gcloud KMS env). On runner: `sops -d secrets/staging.yaml` -> invalid key.
Sofia: Can you paste the CI snippet?
Mike: ```yaml
# .gitlab-ci.yml snippet
deploy-staging:
  script:
    - sops -d secrets/staging.yaml > /tmp/dec.yaml
    - helm upgrade --install app ./chart -f /tmp/dec.yaml
  variables:
    SOPS_AGE_KEY: "$SOPS_AGE_KEY"
```
Rahul: Looks like the runner image preinstalled sops but not the AGE key in file system. We inject SOPS_AGE_KEY as masked variable, but job runners use docker:dind and the entrypoint doesn't write to ~/.config/sops/age/keys.txt.
Anya: Two paths: make CI write AGE key file at runtime (in before_script), or switch to decrypt-by-kms in runner using GCP service account. Which is less risky?
Mike: Quick fix pushed: before_script writes $SOPS_AGE_KEY to /tmp/age.key and sets SOPS_AGE_KEY_FILE=/tmp/age.key. PR: https://gitlab.com/redwood/infra/merge_requests/1025
Sofia: That should unblock staging. Long-term we should standardize on KMS wrapper + instance SA with access so we don't store key in variables.
Rahul: Also need to update terraform module that created alias to not rotate until all runners updated. Add a post-rotate checklist.
Oncall-Infra: Created incident INC-2026-045, assigned to Mike. Timeline + mitigation steps added.
Mike: After quick fix staging deploy succeeded. Logs: helm upgrade ok, pods started, env vars populated.
Anya: Follow-up tasks: 1) Update runner images to include a bootstrap that writes AGE key from secure store. 2) Add terraform lock step preventing alias deletion if dependent services exist. 3) Run a repo scan for any other CI jobs that assume key in FS.
Sofia: I'll own the terraform lock. Rahul can you draft the runner bootstrap?
Rahul: On it, will open RFC with options (age file vs KMS decrypt).
Mike: Thanks all — closing thread when RFC posted. :thumbsup:
